location.title: Location
location.description: The location where the dedicated host group will be created.

resource_group_name.title: Resource Group Name
resource_group_name.description: The resource group where dedicated host group will be deployed.

automatic_placement_enabled.title: Automatic Placement Enabled
automatic_placement_enabled.description: Whether or not automatic placement is enabled for the host group.

enable_telemetry.title: Enable Telemetry
enable_telemetry.description: This variable controls whether or not telemetry is enabled for the module. For more information see <https://aka.ms/avm/telemetryinfo>. If it is set to false, then no telemetry will be collected.

zone.title: Zone
zone.description: The Availability Zone for the Dedicated Host Group.

dedicated_host_group_name.title: Dedicated Host Group Name
dedicated_host_group_name.description: The name of the dedicated host.

platform_fault_domain_count.title: Platform Fault Domain Count
platform_fault_domain_count.description: The number of fault domains that the host group can span.

dedicated_hosts.title: Dedicated Hosts
dedicated_hosts.description: (Optional) A map of the hosts and their specifications in the Dedicated Host Group
dedicated_hosts.tfType:
map(object({
    name                    = string
    sku_name                = string
    auto_replace_on_failure = optional(bool, true)
    platform_fault_domain   = number
    license_type            = optional(string, "None")
    tags                    = optional(map(string), null)
  }))
